reviews.name: Kaitlyn Hendry
reviews.text: PAMMY IS THE BEST!!! Since I met her in 2019 I haven't looked back. She is the best in all aspects, personality, atmosphere, vibes, service, and most importantly educating her clients in the process before I met Pam I had hairdressers frying my hair until It fell off because no one cared to take a moment and explain and guide me in the right direction to achieve my hair goals in a healthy way. Pam cares about her clients and the integrity of their hair and that's so hard to find!!! She delivers amazing results and my hair is the healthiest it's ever been all thanks to her. Thank you for always making me feel so beautiful on the inside and out at every visit. A beautiful and talented soul in this industry

reviews.name: Luna Chimerakis
reviews.text: I've been going to Pam for 5+ years, I absolutely adore her! Whether it's blonde, a new fun color, correcting my at home mistakes, etc, She sets realistic expectations on your hair journey all while getting the results perfect every time. She's also like my therapist, every appointment she's there to listen to my hair and/or life crash outs. I will never forget in the first years of seeing her I decided to go to a different hair girl for highlights. Big mistake, It looked horrific. I called Pam crying in a panic to help because I've never had my hair look so bad. She immediately fit me into her schedule and made my hair look perfectly blonde like it never happened. That's when I knew I would never go to anyone else.

reviews.name: Mari C
reviews.text: Pam is the best! Always reliable and always great vibes. She really takes the time to understand your goal and educate you. Great service and attention to detail. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Illy Perez
reviews.text: being a military brat, I've lived in and traveled to a lot of different places. no matter where i am, i'll always make the drive, plan the trip, or wait until i'm back in town just to have my hair done by her. she's the ONLY person i trust with my hair. i've had every opportunity to find someone closer, but i never do because nobody compares. i always leave loving my hair, and if i'm willing to travel just to sit in her chair, i think that says everything you need to know. she's truly the best in the game!!!

reviews.name: Megan Perdomo
reviews.text: I've been going to Pam for years, and I truly can't imagine trusting anyone else with my hair. Every single appointment, she somehow manages to exceed my expectations. Whether it's a fresh cut, color, or style, I always leave feeling more confident than when I walked in. What makes Pam so special isn't just her incredible talent, it's the experience she creates. Sitting in her chair feels like catching up with your best friend. She's so easy to talk to, genuinely cares about her clients, and makes every appointment something I actually look forward to. If you're looking for someone who is not only amazingly skilled but also kind, welcoming, and passionate about what she does, Pam is the one. I can't recommend her enough!
